messages:
Alex: Quick design review: multi-axis charts in Console v2. I threw together a small interaction for mapping series to axes and surfacing units without clutter. See screenshot: https://preview.redwood/ui/multi-axis-compact.png
Rachael: Nice. Main concerns: 1) keyboard accessibility for the axis mapping UI, 2) concise copy for small screens, 3) how legend overflow behaves on tiny widths.
Sam: For legends: propose a compact chip that includes a micro-axis badge (L or R) and truncated unit. e.g., 'Payment latency • L • ms' with tooltip expanding full unit + description. Overflow should collapse to a single 'More' chip that opens a menu.
Priya: Language: prefer human-friendly units: 'Latency (ms)', 'Throughput (req/s)'. Avoid internal abbreviations like 'rps'. Also prefer 'per second' spelled in tooltip content for clarity for non-technical users.
Alex: Smoothing controls: should we expose a short preset selector (None / 5pt / 25pt) with labels 'None / Light / Strong' and a numeric modal for advanced users? Keeps main chrome minimal.
Rachael: Agreed. Microcopy examples (concise): 'Smoothing — 5-point (light)' and longer explanatory: 'Smoothing averages adjacent points to reduce noise; use 25-point to reveal long-term trend.' Keep main label under 40 chars.
Sam: Outlier handling: two modes: Dim (visual fade) vs Remove (filter). Recommendation: default to Dim so the data context remains. Dimming should be subtle (~40% opacity) and paired with an optional pattern/hatch on hover for a11y. Add an export option to let CSVs omit suppressed outliers.
Priya: Accessibility: ensure dimming still meets contrast with colorblind palettes; if not, add a crosshatch overlay on the dimmed series when focused. Also legend items need aria-labels that include axis and unit. Example: aria-label="Payment latency, left axis, unit milliseconds, visible".
Rachael: Keyboard flow: focusable legend list -> expand more menu -> focus chart area -> tooltip. Tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and dismissible by Esc. Axis mapping popover must trap focus while open and announce changes.
DesignBot: Uploaded prototype: https://assets.redwood/mocks/multi-axis-2056789012.png :thumbsup:
Alex: Action items: Rachael to produce three short copy options (concise / explanatory / help-tour), Sam to mock legend chips + overflow menu and pattern overlay concept, Priya to produce aria snippets + contrast checklist. Sync Friday 9am PT. Thanks!
